process_description: Assigns an advocate to a tenant case via UserRelationship.ADVOCACY. Exports case summary data for a set of tenant user_ids as JSON (or CSV via accept header). Generates an aggregate report of all cases in the manager's organization. Generates per-staff productivity metrics (cases handled, docs reviewed, events created). Updates a staff member's default_role. Manager can set advocate or user roles only.
